verdict.rationale: Snyk provides AI-generated insights via DeepCode AI (85%-accurate autofixes, hybrid AI query matching), risk-based prioritization scoring, and an LLM-driven Remediation Agent that scans, generates fix plans enriched with security intelligence, applies fixes, and verifies results directly in the IDE/CLI/coding assistant. These are backed by docs and confirmed working MCP server/CLI probes, though community feedback questions overall tool quality/noise.
